summary: Phase 12 — Tenant-controlled Arabic locale + Admin Guide. Backend: 8/8 new tests PASS + Phase10 (24/24) + Phase11 (33/34, 1 unrelated regression) = 65/66. Frontend: 16/16 critical flows verified — locale gating (ISB/EAIC/UoB), Admin Guide page (10 steps, all testids), sidebar role-gating across 5 roles (super_admin, institution_admin, faculty, registrar, compliance, student), InstitutionSetup Switch end-to-end (toggle ON → reload persists → lang-ar appears → toggle OFF → lang-ar disappears), EAIC AI Instructor still shows Arabic title + 'AR + EN' KPI.

minor.issue: test_ai_usecases_isb_has_4_active_4_pending now sees 5 active modules instead of 4 (psychometrics appears active). Phase-11 test, not Phase-12 — flag for main agent to either update the asserted count to 5 or revisit if psychometrics should still be coming-soon.

issues: Recharts emits warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first paint of multiple dashboard charts. Non-blocking but should add minWidth/minHeight or aspect ratio to the ResponsiveContainer wrapper.

action_items: (Optional) Update Phase-11 assertion test_ai_usecases_isb_has_4_active_4_pending: active count is now 5 (psychometrics promoted). Pre-existing, not caused by Phase 12.
(Optional, minor) Suppress Recharts width(-1) warning on first paint by giving ResponsiveContainer an explicit min height or aspect.
critical_code_review_comments: useTenantLocale.js correctly resolves arabicEnabled via current.locale_arabic_enabled with sensible country-name fallback. Good single source of truth.
LanguageSwitcher useEffect auto-recovers lang to 'en' when arabicEnabled flips false — direct verification (toggle-off then page reload) confirms lang-ar disappears.
InstitutionSetup PATCH payload correctly persists locale_arabic_enabled and refresh() is awaited before toast — race-free.

PATCH /api/institutions/{id} authorization scoping is correct: 403 for student, 403 cross-tenant institution_admin, 200 for super_admin + tenant-matching institution_admin. Audit row 'institution.update' is written with actor + changes list.
AdminGuide testid scheme matches request: data-testid='admin-guide-page', 'admin-guide-steps', 'admin-guide-quickref', 'admin-guide-step-<key>', 'admin-guide-step-<key>-cta'.

Sidebar role-gating uses NAV.filter((item) => !item.roles || item.roles.includes(user?.role)) — clean and the 'admin-guide' entry restricts to ['super_admin','institution_admin']. Verified empirically for 6 roles.

Radix Accordion CTAs unmount when collapsed (default for type='multiple'); cta testids only present in DOM for currently-expanded items. If headless tests want all 10 cta testids visible at once, consider <AccordionContent forceMount> or use defaultValue with all step keys.

success_rate.backend: 100% on Phase 12 (8/8). 98.5% overall (65/66 including older phases)
